notes:
POC focused on ticket/email summarization + auto-tagging for Zendesk workflows. Key ask: reduce average handle time by 20% and cut triage time. They operate on ~500k inbound tickets/month (across customers) but POC uses subset (~50k). Typical ticket size: 200-800 chars; many multipart email threads.

Requirements/constraints: must map suggested tags to existing Zendesk macros and triggers (they have 120 active macros). Prefer hosted API for speed of iteration but mid-market customers will require VPC for data residency. Interested in Dedicated for SLA-backed throughput if POC passes.

Reliability: spikes during product releases and marketing campaigns produce 6-8x baseline load; they care about graceful degradation and fallback routing to a cheaper model rather than 503s. Quote from Head of Ops: "If summaries lag, agents ignore them — need sub-300ms median summary gen and 95th <1s for agent UI".

Integration notes: want a Zendesk app / sidebar component that shows suggested summary + tags + macro recommendation; clicking macro should trigger Zendesk macro call. Also want Freshdesk compatibility for a few customers.

POC results so far: automated summaries readable but missing entity extraction for product SKUs (false negatives). Tagging model fine-tunes badly on small sample; need better taxonomy alignment and a feedback loop for agent corrections.

Sales/ops artifacts: pricing deck in Drive, security FAQ, initial SLA draft. Legal: open question around retention controls and audit logging for EU customers.

Next: run scale test week of 2026-03-10, define POC SLA for 99th pct latency, deliver mapping tool for macros.
